sentences.en: He was dependent on contribution for a part of capital.
sentences.zh: 他有一部分资金依赖于捐款。

sentences.en: I'd like to thank you for your very generous contribution.
sentences.zh: 我想感谢你慷慨的捐赠。

sentences.en: He made a great contribution to research into cancer.
sentences.zh: 他对癌症研究做出了巨大贡献。

senses.zh: 贡献，捐赠，捐助,捐赠，捐助物,投稿，来稿,军（向占领地人民征收的）军税
